uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7841.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Darksteel Angel
When Darksteel Angel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

465-585-1879-3742-4251.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Phantom Steed to become a Samurai until end of turn.
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

1429-3545-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2034-2728-5662-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2034-2728-5662-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2034-2728-5662-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

1011-2438-2728-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2438-2728-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2438-2728-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 4.

880-2653-7892.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Nissa and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

5315-6972-7782.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Clockwork Hydra.
When Clockwork Hydra dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

431-851-2557-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-2557-7824.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

3698-4694-7652.easyPrerequisites: Tom, Bert, and William is an artifact.
3698-4694-7652.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tom, Bert, and William.
When Tom, Bert, and William die, they trigger, returning them from your graveyard to the battlefield as a noncreature artifact.
Because Tom, Bert, and William enter as a noncreature artifact, March of the Machines will then cause Tom, Bert, and William to be a 5/5 artifact creature.
When Tom, Bert and William enter, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

1824-2530-3168-5061.manaNeeded: {B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1824-2530-3168-5061.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-3168-5061.description:
Cast Acererak either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Staff of the Death Magus triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

814-2079-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
814-2079-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1698-3260-3540-4668.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four creatures.
You have at least three opponents.
Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
1698-3260-3540-4668.description:
Cast Mourning by paying 2 life if able, or {B} otherwise.
Each creature you control's extort ability triggers.
Resolve the first extort trigger, causing you to pay 2 life if able, or {W/B} otherwise, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining extort trigger.
Resolve Mourning, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Mourning by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat until an opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
1698-3260-3540-4668.notes: Once you have two or less opponents, the combo no longer makes enough life to continue. You may repeat the loop using your own resources as desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1358-3062-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Sydri
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-6633-6723-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-6633-6723-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1387-1500-2871-5644.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}. Birgi, Blood Funnel and Judith trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Judith trigger, creating a 2/2 Imp creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Imp.
When the Imp dies, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Seething Anger spell.
Repeat.

826-2534-3899-6243.notablePrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-2534-3899-6243.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, removing all creature types from Coercive Recruiter.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Coercive Recruiter.
When Coercive Recruiter dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel with flying and a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Amoeboid Changeling.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

579-1491-2757-6218.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Pheres-Band Tromper, untapping a basic land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {2}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1879-5696-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
1879-5696-5702.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

774-3470-5233.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2292-2486--5.notablePrerequisites:
The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You control your commander.
2292-2486--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to your commander's ability granted to it by Master Chef.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1678-4767.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Silverclad Ferocidons indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Silverclad Ferocidons.
1678-4767.description:
Give Silverclad Ferocidons indestructible, if needed, then deal any amount of damage to it.
Silverclad Ferocidons triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a permanent.
Mayhem Devil triggers for each permanent sacrificed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to Silverclad Ferocidons.
Repeat from step 2 until no opponent controls a permanent.
Resolve all remaining Mayhem Devil triggers, dealing that much damage divided as you choose among any number of targets.

2690-5369-5370.description:
Activate Rattleclaw Mystic's morph ability by paying {2}, turning it face-up.
Ratteclaw Mystic triggers twice, adding {G}{G}{U}{U}{R}{R}.
Activate Master of the Veil's morph ability by paying {2}{U}, turning it face-up.
Master of the Veil triggers twice, turning Rattleclaw Mystic and Master of the Veil face-down.
Repeat.

2009-2021-2289.notablePrerequisites:
Sovereign Okinec Ahau does not have summoning sickness.
Other creatures you control have total power 10 or greater.
2009-2021-2289.description:
Activate Mossbridge Troll by tapping any other creatures you control except Sovereign Okinec Ahau with total power 10 or greater, giving Mossbridge Troll +20/+20 until end of turn.
Declare Sovereign Okinec Ahau as an attacker.
Sovereign Okinec Ahau triggers, putting twenty +1/+1 counters on Mossbridge Troll.
Simic Ascendancy's first ability triggers, putting 20 growth counters on it.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy's second ability triggers, causing you to win the game.

2966-3253-4050-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Zopandrel has at least one indestructible counter on it, and at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one additional permanent.
2966-3253-4050-4613.description:
Activate Zopandrel using Myojin of Blooming Dawn's ability by removing an indestructible counter from it, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token for each permanent you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Spirits, adding {2}.
Activate Zopandrel by paying {2} and sacrificing two Spirits, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Repeat.
If you control at least two additional permanents as the combo starts, this combo nets infinite creature tokens and colored mana.

3476-4618-4679.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {2}.
 Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
3476-4618-4679.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Instill Energy attached to the mana-producing creature, then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
Activate the Instill Energy token by paying {0}, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Activate Phantatog's first ability by sacrificing the Instill Energy token, causing Phantatog to get +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3165-3532-4985-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3165-3532-4985-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1329-3263-4487-4853.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-3263-4487-4853.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Marauder from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Marauder by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Marauder enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

1789-3051-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Dragon.
1789-3051-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Boneyard Scourge, adding {1}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another Dragon, adding {B}.
When the Dragon dies, Boneyard Scourge triggers, causing you to pay {1}{B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Boneyard Scourge enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
Repeat.

678-1281-2452.description:
Cast Stitched Assistant by paying {0}.
When Stitched Assistant enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Stitched Assistant dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1231-1601-1636.notablePrerequisites:
Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken creature with mana value eight or greater.
1231-1601-1636.description:
Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value eight or greater, adding at least eight {B}.
Activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning the creature with mana value eight or greater from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1902-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Wirewood Channeler does not have summoning sickness. There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Wirewood Channeler.
1902-5200.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Wirewood Channeler
Repeat.
1902-5200.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

1278-3525-4508.notablePrerequisites:
Lightning-Rig Crew does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Lightning-Rig Crew.
1278-3525-4508.description:
Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating at least one Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping it and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Lightning-Rig Crew.
Repeat.
